issues.detail: Usage-limit interruption delayed attempt until shared 60-minute wall-active budget expired. Operational gaps count active. Parent directed accounting only, no authoring resume.
First setup script initialized Session then failed printing tool metadata under cp1252 with UnicodeEncodeError for U+2192. Context-manager shutdown ran. No Session.call occurred in that invocation.

Initial schema lookup used nonexistent process_workflow.py, designer_workflow.py and process_profile.py names; corrected by reading actual design_process.py, study_session.py and designer.py. One rg wildcard command had invalid filename syntax.
Two command-schema shell queries failed: UTF-8 metadata decoded as cp1252, then list response treated as dictionary. Read-only failures with no document change.

Proposed extended builder script patch failed verification because delete and add targeted same driver.py. No extended builder script was installed or executed; combined exec stopped before shell authoring.
No permitted remaining active build time. Preserved gateway run remains active revision 0; accounting report records budget_exhausted without mutating run or ledger.

owned_process_check: CIM process command-line audit showed two VectorCraft processes rooted in other projects or repository root; no process rooted in this exact trial. No processes killed and no new Gateway opened.
